strings.text: Buttons in horizontal rows scale up in the centre and shrink at the edges while scrolling.
Fills the profile background with the person's personal colour: their NFT gift status, Premium profile colour, or a Whitegram colour.
Blurs the background around the avatar while it is expanded.
Uses a blurred copy of the person's avatar as the profile background.
Uses a blurred copy of the current track's cover art as the player background.
Picks animated particles (snow, stars and so on) that fall over the interface.
